europe_now.title: Finland rejects Russian demands regarding NATO
europe_now.summary: Finland has formally pushed back against reported conditions from Moscow demanding that the country leave NATO as part of any future peace negotiations. The development highlights ongoing geopolitical friction concerning European security arrangements and regional defense alignments.

sources.headline: Finland rejects reported Russian demand to leave NATO as part of peace talks

europe_now.title: Mass mobilizations and protests across France
europe_now.summary: France has deployed 70,000 police officers as the country faces a fifth successive wave of anti-government and student demonstrations. The large-scale civil unrest reflects growing societal tensions and widespread public discontent over domestic policies.

sources.headline: Live: France mobilises in fifth wave of student protests
Live: France deploys 70,000 police for new wave of anti-government protests

top_stories.title: European Diplomatic Strategy for Ukraine
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders have designated a group of major continental powers alongside Brussels representatives to coordinate diplomatic engagement for upcoming peace negotiations. This joint representation replaces the proposal for a single dedicated European envoy.

sources.headline: France among five major powers to represent EU in Ukraine talks
EU leaders hand Ukraine peace talks to France, Germany, UK, Italy, Poland plus Brussels – instead of a single envoy

top_stories.title: Global Technology Infrastructure Recovery
top_stories.summary: Microsoft confirmed that all consumer products and business services have fully recovered following a massive global outage that disrupted operations. The widespread digital failure has renewed political discussions within Europe regarding technological dependence on foreign providers.
